rationale: Consistent visual language across the application helps users build mental models and reduces cognitive load. Focus indicators are especially important for accessibility and should be predictable throughout the application.
problemSolved: ParliamentList and InitiativeList use `focus:ring-blue-500` (raw Tailwind color). GlobalSearch uses `focus:ring-accent-7`. DeputySelector uses `focus:ring-accent-9`. DistrictSelector and PartySelector use `focus:ring-accent-7`. This inconsistency is confusing for users.
